args.does: packet 0b folder gate for designs/<id>: files, exact brief sizes, audit PASS, SHIP 8+, assets listed; prints BUILT PASS or the first FAIL line

args.name: round
args.does: packet 0b remainder (NEED-09): print the ROUND real yes/no line (built/judged/delivered/adopted/tools/unjudged-oldest/in-flight); --save also writes sprint/queue/round.md; exit 1 when real no
